messages:
Maya: Pushed a PRD draft for the model rollout + A/B canary. Please review acceptance criteria, pinning rules, and rollback thresholds. Doc: https://redwood.internal/prd/model-rollout-canary (internal)

Oliver: Read it. My take — start with 5% canary for 24h, then 25% for 24h, then 100% if green. Key signals: p95 latency, total error rate, and the "quality_delta" on our sentinel prompts. Need tenant pin semantics so enterprise customers can opt out.

Rachel: From metrics side: agree on signals. Suggest primary test be Bayesian sequential A/B on the quality metric with a stop rule: stop and rollback if posterior(probability that quality_delta < -2%) > 0.90. Also require minimum sample N=20k requests or 24h whichever is larger. I'll drop SQL queries into the doc.

Sanjay: Ops checklist: require 30-minute synthetic warmup that primes KV caches and warms kernels. Healthchecks: 5xx rate, p99 latency, GPU mem OOMs, and any request timeouts. Auto-rollback conditions: (1) p99 latency increase >=40% sustained for >3m, (2) error rate increase >=0.7% absolute for >3m, (3) any node OOM. Need a manual abort button in the Console and a runbook link.

Emily: CS asks for per-tenant pinning feature. Acceptance: tenants with a pinned version must be excluded from rollout weighting and must be addressable by an API header `X-Client-Model-Override`. Pinned setting must be visible and editable in Console with audit log.

Oliver: Clarifying routing precedence:
- API header `X-Client-Model-Override` has highest precedence.
- Console tenant pin (if set) overrides global rollout config.
- Else use rollout weights by traffic allocation.

Oliver: Ops config example (YAML):
```
rollout:
  steps:
    - percent: 5
      duration_hours: 24
      version: "v3.0-canary"
    - percent: 25
      duration_hours: 24
      version: "v3.0-canary"
  warmup_minutes: 30
  rollback_rules:
    p99_latency_pct_increase: 40
    error_rate_absolute_pct: 0.7
    sustained_minutes: 3
  compatibility_check: true
```

Maya: Acceptance checklist (please thumbs-up if you sign off):
- Staging smoke: responses look valid, no crashes
- Warmup completes without OOMs and cache primed
- p99 latency regression <40% vs baseline across canary windows
- Error rate delta <0.7% absolute
- Quality regression <2% on primary sentinel prompts
- Tenant pin respected by API and Console UI
- Observability: dashboards, alerts, and runbook linked
- Rollback automation exercised in staging

Rachel: I'll add the sequential Bayesian analysis notebook and MDE calc. Also create the dashboard panels for the quality metric and posterior trace.

Sanjay: I'll implement the warmup job and add the alert runbook. Ops will execute a manual abort drill in staging tomorrow.

Emily: We'll notify a small group of pilot customers; offer pinning if they want to opt out. Also prep customer comms kit.

Oliver: Edge case to handle — byte-incompatible model variants (KV cache/layout mismatch). Pipeline should block auto-rollout and surface compatibility error; fallback to nearest compatible variant if available.

Maya: Added compatibility gating and the pinning UI mockups to the PRD. Can we aim for signoff by EOD Friday? If not, schedule rollout in next-week off-peak window.

Maya: Thanks — updating the PRD with Rachel/Sanjay edits now. :pray:
